order: published design audit and strong classical baselines
new survey only if increment passes
new-design power only if survey proceeds
hard_constraints: no relabelling generated designs as published field designs
no new fielding or spending before contribution gate
no choosing a new statistic solely for significance
contribution_pass_conditions: a useful operation or result not supplied by equivalent classical lack-of-fit/discrimination formulation
verified scope on reproducible published designs
fair comparison under the same alternative, budget and response metric
failure_action: stop repackaging current framework; provide a concrete research-pivot decision and do not collect redundant questionnaires
